title.zh: Keys Not Included: recovering the signing keys for US driver's license barcodes

current_state.zh: A security researcher reverse-engineers and recovers the ECDSA signing keys used to authenticate US driver's license barcode data, exposing weaknesses in the current ID verification scheme.
